fresh_test_rule: Exclude the 400 official-test examples sampled with seed 42 in the earlier pilot, then stratify-sample 400 with seed 43.
tie_break: first configuration in the declared order
additional_experiment: fixed four-shot versus train-only TF-IDF retrieved four-shot, with model and prompt style held constant
prior_work: The 128-training-example pilot and its test results are exploratory and excluded from the final result table. Four unchanged full-size Qwen prompt-validation trials from the prior development attempt are reused because their data, model revision, prompts and scoring are unchanged. Two earlier short-style retrieval validation trials are retained as preliminary records. Final full-data training and fresh-test results are newly run.
development_update: After the initial SmolLM2 one-shot validation accuracy was 3.25%, explicit-final-instruction and alternating-chat-turn four-shot formats were added for both models. This adaptive change used validation results only; the fresh test was still sealed.
